digest.component_or_area: review-bot persistent tickets clone and autodeploy
propositions: The review-bot's EBS-backed persistent tickets clone does not refresh on redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, causing divergent history to persist across redeployments.

The entrypoint invokes reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block, so convergence must run when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset; the current ensure script does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset divergent clones.

autodeploy.sh omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS, preventing the deploy decision and rsync from delivering changes to these scripts, blocking self-deployment of future ensure-script modifications.

Convergence must use reconverge for compatible stores and remain best-effort to never undo or wedge an already-cast vote; a narrow adoption path resets only pre-epoch clones when the pre-fetch local tip is an ancestor of the readable prior remote tip.

Fetch must use explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets and fail gracefully with a warning when credentials are absent or origin is unreachable, preserving the local tip and returning success to prevent vote abortion.
